status: Pre-registered before any scoring of the 323-case reserve or the 10-case Q4 calendar cohort.
launch_readiness: Draft. The packet, scoring and corroboration prototypes are archived. Primary endpoint execution requires a verified changed-file population, full alert spans, a sealed arm and tier key, and source-bound corroboration.

tier_policy.finding: alerts from rules whose metadata.confidence is HIGH or MEDIUM
tier_policy.lead: alerts from rules whose metadata.confidence is LOW (listed for review; nothing is suppressed)
tier_policy.wiring: deep_audit_sarif._sarif_result_finding sets report_tier from the SARIF rule tag "<LEVEL> CONFIDENCE"; missing or unknown confidence stays a finding. Gates are unchanged.

demotion.criterion_D1: A MEDIUM rule becomes LOW when, at candidate 60f1d3b9 with the main 82c8ada5 scorer, it contributes no hunk-hit case on exposed-161 or Q2 AND its labeled exposed-161 precision is below 60% with at least 5 labeled alerts.
demotion.inputs: exposed-161 and Q2 (tuning cohorts) and the adjudicated exposed label sets on main; see tuning-rule-table.txt

result.php.request-html-injection: 0 hit cases; 27 TP / 21 FP labeled (56%); 130 alerts -> LOW

demotion.not_adopted: A third background tier for LOW rules with no tuning hits (python.parameter-sql-text, go.request-html-injection): no effect on finding-tier precision.

disclosure: Q3 alerts at 60f1d3b9 were blind-labeled on 2026-11-27 before this record, and per-tier Q3 results were seen. Q3 is therefore not a confirmation of this policy; the reserve is. No Q3 label is used by any rule or criterion.

primary: finding-tier precision = TP/(TP+FP) over finding-tier old-side alerts in changed files, Wilson 95% interval
finding-tier recall = scored cases with a hunk hit from a finding-tier rule / scored cases
endpoints.arms: frozen candidate vs main, same scorer, engine and profile

labeling_protocol.population: census of finding-tier alerts; lead-tier census up to 300 alerts, otherwise a seeded (20261127) sample of 300
labeling_protocol.packet: build_packet.py: repository, file, line, span, claimed weakness, code context (+-5 and +-40 lines, file imports); no advisory id, rule id, arm, tier or outcome
labeling_protocol.reviewers: arm 1 fresh Claude Opus agents, arm 2 fresh Claude Sonnet agents, disjoint packet parts, reading only their part, no web
labeling_protocol.judge: one fresh Fable 5.2 agent on the disagreements, reading only the judge packet
labeling_protocol.final: score_labels.py: agreed verdict, else the judge verdict

candidate.commit: the commit that adds this record, on #431 (claude/port-q2-rules)

arm_C_codeql_corroboration.status: secondary, pre-registered 2026-11-27 before the reserve or Q4 is scored
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.definition: finding = MEDIUM/HIGH alert, or a LOW alert with a CodeQL old-side result (profile codeql-<lang>-full, --ram={ram_mib}) of the same weakness family (CWE tag map in corroborate_tuning.py) whose primary location or any code-flow step is in the same file within 3 lines; lead = every other LOW alert
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.scope: cases in CodeQL-supported ecosystems (PyPI, npm, RubyGems, Maven); other cases fall back to the tier policy and are reported separately
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.endpoints: arm C finding-tier precision and recall on the reserve, beside the tier-only arm, from the same labeled alerts
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.tuning_evidence: exposed-161, 83 CodeQL-scanned cases, head a73d398c: LOW corroborated 9 alerts, labeled 2 TP / 2 FP; LOW uncorroborated 51 alerts, 7 TP / 25 FP; finding-tier hit cases 14 -> 19 of 34. Small samples, tuning data.

arm_D_two_engine_agreement.status: secondary, pre-registered 2026-11-27 before the reserve or Q4 is scored, and before any CodeQL scan of a Q3 case
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.definition: finding = a pattern alert of any tier with a same-family CodeQL old-side result touching the same file within 3 lines (as in arm C); every other alert is a lead
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.target: finding-tier precision >= 6x the Q3 overall pattern precision at 60f1d3b9 (8.2%), i.e. >= 49%; reported with its Wilson interval and alert count
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.scope: CodeQL-supported ecosystems (PyPI, npm, RubyGems, Maven); others reported separately

codeql_corroboration_lane.method: old side only; analyze with the scored-family query suites below (security-extended queries whose CWE tags map to the scored families, plus every diagnostics query) instead of the full suite; scanned only for cases with at least one old-side pattern alert in changed files, the only cases where corroboration can change a tier
codeql_corroboration_lane.equivalence: on exposed GHSA-23fx, -72qq, -7vxr, -3xgr the family suite gave identical same-family corroboration locations to the full suite (0, 60, 8, 10)
codeql_corroboration_lane.speed: per-case wall 809 s -> 351 s on those four cases (2.3x); with alerted-cases-only about 10x or more for a reserve-sized cohort
